steps.text: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
A big improvement
It makes much better background noise too
What have you got?
A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
Looks peaceful
It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
Only if it's actually hanging up
It is, before you ask for proof
Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
I need to go back. I'll text you when I'm out
Talk later
Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.

steps.text: You look good with your hair down
Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
I can admire you and read a schedule
Then try doing the second one
Much less interesting
It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
You were hardly subtle
I wasn't trying to be
Clearly
Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
To your place?
That's where my kitchen is
You know why I'm asking
And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
We talked about this yesterday
You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
I meant the rest of that conversation
I had a really good evening with him
I'm sure you did
Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
You make everything sound so simple
Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
You enjoyed the other night
And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
I'm not giving you an answer now
Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
Let me finish this first

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: {{name:lena}} turns back to the open schedule on the desk
Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.

steps.text: Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
That's everything. I'll put these with the others
Leave them there, I'll take them out
You could have said that before I sorted them
They're sorted now
You really do enjoy being in charge
Look at me a second
What?
I want another kiss
You know why I'm hesitating
I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
Okay... just a kiss

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: After her answer, the manager gets up and steps closer to {{name:lena}}
He leans in to kiss her and draws her a little closer by the waist; she returns the kiss

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.

steps.text: Okay, that's enough
I liked that better than the paperwork
I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
I preferred today's decision
Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
I'm leaving now
I'll text you about dinner later
I still haven't agreed
I heard you. Think about it
After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
Everything finished?
Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
Yeah, one less thing
I'll text you when I'm inside
Okay, talk in a bit
